title: Personal Safety Deescalation
description: Covers situational awareness and body language, warning signs and pre-attack indicators, and what to do and say to de-escalate. Explains creating distance and escaping when that fails, handling verbal confrontations, road rage, and home intrusion, and how self-defense laws vary.
shortDescription: Spot escalation early, talk a situation down, and escape if it fails
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
